v0.1.0.description:
First public verison of the mod.

It allows to play in endless mode with Archipelago multiworld.

Setup guide is in repo's REAMDE file.

Pretty stable, but game can occassionally crash, so you lose a run.
v0.1.0.title: v0.1.0

v0.2.0.description:
# Changes
- Added regions for more controlled generations especially of items from other games.
- Added options to be able to receive Talents/Divine relics in order - this reduces randomness, but also reduces choices. Default off.

Those changes can resolve some ultra randomness issues with the implementation for people who don't like another one above Archipelago.
v0.2.0.title: Children of Morta Archipelago Mod - v0.2.0

v0.3.0.description:
# Children Of Morta AP Mod v0.3.0

This is a stability patch for the client mod.

# Improvements

- Mod unlocks Endless mode even if you didn't do so yet.
- Better multi-run state handling

# Bug Fixes

- Changed the way items are received to prevent some item receiving crashes
v0.3.0.title: v0.3.0

v0.3.2.description:
# Children of Morta Archipelago Mod v0.3.2
## Changes
Changed in game chat box to more performant version - it doesn't drop FPS so much:
- display works the same - show up for 8s when something new pops-up and shows up on character select/when game is paused (in background).
- uses in-game font now
- connection box without changes
- chat messages/commands can't be typed inside the game now - use Text Client for that.


Blank items now have grey icon to easy spot them - thanks @ Eilis Talvi for suggestion.

### APWorld didn't change (from v0.2.0) but bundled it with release for convinience.
v0.3.2.title: v0.3.2
